styleSelection.reason: Requested urban sketch: sepia pen carries the village structure (roofs, walls, windows, cypresses, pine limbs); one pale wash per area, then one shadow glaze, so the paper still breathes through the lit walls and paths.

families.referenceCue: upper village: pale ochre and violet-grey walls, terracotta roofs, small dark windows
pale blue-green distant hills, lightest and coolest area
ochre terraces and dry-stone walls, cypress columns, olive rows
stone houses: warm lit faces, violet shadow sides, burnt-sienna roofs; focal point
rounded olive and oak masses, yellow-green lit tops, blue-green shadow undersides
dense dark green trees and cypresses behind the houses
ochre path and olive trees on the left slope
large foreground pine: yellow-green crown, dark branching trunk
pale path and rocks, scattered shrubs, broken lights
